utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I can check in while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, Ira. If you hear anything, just let me know what they need and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and tell you as soon as I hear what they need and when it’s set for.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive—just send me the basics and I’ll skim it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the basics over in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and take a quick look when you send it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, so the repair drive is still happening, right? Just checking before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’d wait to spread the word until we confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll hold off and wait for confirmation before I mention it to anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm in, I think. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few basics: duct tape, spare screws, and a working flashlight. I can check what’s on hand if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, please do—I probably have the flashlight somewhere. If not, I can bring duct tape and check the junk drawer for screws.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help—what details do you want me to check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks. Could you check what kind of repairs they’re collecting, and where to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check that for you—what repairs they’re collecting and the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — could you help sort donations into tools, paint, and hardware?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I can start with the tools and hardware right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill, a couple screwdrivers, and maybe a flashlight? If you can help sort the donated parts when you get here, that’d be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Gus — I’ll bring the drill, screwdrivers, and a flashlight, and I can help sort the donated parts when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive on my radar—where are we meeting, and what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s meet at the school parking lot by the main entrance at 3:30. I’ll be there with the boxes, and we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — school parking lot by the main entrance at 3:30. I’ll be there and ready to help with the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of interest already. If you want, I can pass along the latest details when I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — please do, and I’ll pass it along to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rey — what’s the repair drive focusing on, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Mina — it’s mostly small home fixes and tool swaps right now. If you can help, we could use extra hands sorting donations or checking in on requests.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help sort donations. When and where should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help out with the repair drive and I’ll spread the word to the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s really kind of you — thanks for spreading the word. I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll let folks know and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m mapping out the repair drive now. Can you tell me which homes need the most urgent help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure I should point to anyone by name, but there are a few places with leaking roofs and broken steps that need attention soon. I can show you which ones when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would help a lot, Uli — thank you. If you can show me the spots with the most urgent repairs, I’ll make sure we prioritize them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need details, I can ask around and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. If you get the schedule, please let me know and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here now—how can I help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Glad you made it—can you help sort the donation bins and then we’ll load up the tools?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I can sort the donation bins first, then help load the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon. Do you need a hand with anything for it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m okay for now, but I may ask if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just let me know if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the repair drive and a small screwdriver set? I’ll be by the garage when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the repair drive and a small screwdriver set and head to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you share the date, time, and location, plus a quick note that people should bring any broken items they want checked?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll share them around. I’ll make sure to mention the date, time, location, and that folks should bring any broken items to check.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the update; what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — we’re meeting Saturday morning at the community center, and any tools or spare parts you can bring would really help. If you can, please stop by around 9.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday at 9, community center. I’ll see what tools and spare parts I can dig up and try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Gus — any word on how the repair drive is going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s coming along nicely — I can swing by with my toolbox if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks — I could use an extra set of hands. Swing by whenever you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes. I’ll get started on that right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure we’ve got the timing and pickup details sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Makes sense—what time works best for you, and do you need a pickup?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do a late morning start, and yes, I’d need a pickup if that’s possible. If you can tell me the exact time and where to meet, I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive today—come by if you can, and I’ll make sure you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Quinn—I’ll stop by and keep an eye on what supplies you still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo—thank you! I’ll put together a quick list so you can see what’s still needed when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I’ll need to know when the repair drive is happening. What time are you aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still pinning that down. I was thinking sometime after school, maybe around 4, so folks can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 sounds workable for me; I can plan around pickup times. Let me know once you’ve got the exact details nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and moving. What’s the first thing you want me to line up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — could you start with the tool sign-up list and let me know who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start the tool sign-up list and track who’s bringing what. I’ll bring you a clean rundown as soon as I’ve got everyone’s names.
